name: Temperature Range Evaluation Under Absolute Zero
description: check_temperature_threshold returns 'CLIPPED_LOW' instead of raising ValueError on sub-absolute zero values.
valid_search_block:
if celsius < -273.15:
        return "CLIPPED_LOW"  # Defect: should raise ValueError("Temperature below absolute zero")
valid_replace_block:
if celsius < -273.15:
        raise ValueError("Temperature below absolute zero")
